STORAGE.NOT_SUPPORTED: The Workspace storage does not support this action.
STORAGE.CONFIG_MISSING: This Workspace has no storage selected. Set it up in Settings.
STORAGE.PULL_CONFLICT: Could not Pull because of conflicts or because the two histories differ. Resolve it manually and try again.
STORAGE.PUSH_REJECTED: Push was rejected. Pull the latest changes and try again.
STORAGE.GIT_AUTH_FAILED: Could not sign in to Git. Check the connection.
STORAGE.GIT_COMMAND_FAILED: The git {command} command did not succeed.
STORAGE.CLONE_FAILED: Could not download the repository. Check the address and your access.
STORAGE.GOOGLE_NOT_CONFIGURED: Google sign-in has not been set up. Contact your administrator.
STORAGE.GOOGLE_AUTH_REQUIRED: Sign in with Google to use Google Drive.
STORAGE.GOOGLE_OAUTH_STATE_INVALID: The Google sign-in session has expired or is not valid. Try again.
STORAGE.GOOGLE_OAUTH_FAILED: Google sign-in did not succeed. Try again.
STORAGE.DRIVE_NOT_FOUND: The folder or file was not found on Google Drive, or you do not have access to it.
STORAGE.DRIVE_REQUEST_FAILED: Could not reach Google Drive. Try again later.
STORAGE.GIT_IDENTITY_MISSING: Git does not have an author name and email yet. Run git config --global user.name "Name" and git config --global user.email "email", then try again.
STORAGE.BRANCH_MISMATCH: This computer is on branch {current}, not the configured branch {expected}. Switch to branch {expected} and try again.
STORAGE.DRIVE_PULL_CONFLICT: Could not Pull from Google Drive because these files on this computer have unsynced changes or are newer than the Drive copy: {files}. Push or discard those changes and try again.
